packageRules.description: The go directive is this library's floor and stays on the oldest supported line; only the toolchain directive follows the newest patch. The global rangeStrategy=bump above otherwise applies to the go directive too: #407 rewrote `go 1.26` + `toolchain go1.27.0` into `go 1.27.1`, which forces every importer onto that patch and made the gosec job fail without a message, because the gosec image ships Go 1.27.0 and refuses a newer go line under GOTOOLCHAIN=local.
